blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Boholano distance runner Jhul Ian Cañalita added another feather to his already decorated cap after winning the gold medal in the 3,000-meter steeplechase at the 18th Southeast Asian (SEA) U18 and U20 Athletics Championships in Thailand. Cañalita dominated the U20 men’s division, clocking 9 minutes and 24.08 seconds to claim the championship on November 6–8 in Pathum Thani. The University of Bohol-Victoriano D. Tirol Advanced Learning Center (UB-VDTALC) student also established a new meet record, finishing comfortably ahead of his rivals from Malaysia and Vietnam.
